item.title: London Tube strike will go ahead after talks collapse
item.body: A strike on the London Underground will go ahead after talks on Tuesday failed to resolve a dispute over a four-day working week.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🚇 London Tube strike will go ahead after talks collapse

A strike on the London Underground will go ahead after talks on Tuesday failed to resolve a dispute over a four-day working week.

Source: BBC | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 24 November, 17:56

#BreakingNews #LondonTube #Strike
